newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police seize big weapons haul.
newsitem.headline: German police seize big weapons haul.

text.p: German police said on Wednesday they had seized a large haul of weapons, including a machine gun, automatic weapons and hand grenades, but they did not think there was any political group behind the arsenal.

Police said the discovery of around 90 weapons and 500 kg (1,100 lbs) of ammunition in northwestern Bavaria ended an investigation against eight men between the ages of 34 and 62, who came from the region.
A judge issued arrest warrants for six of the men. Police said they started the investigation after discovering links between the suspects and a weapons dealing ring broken up by police in 1994.
Police said there seemed to be no political motives behind the hoard and the men were probably weapons fanatics who were acquiring the arms for a collection.
